name: 06016 · Broad Brook, CT
findings: ZIP 06016 (Broad Brook) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (69%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06016 (Broad Brook) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
